actions.create_expense.description: Creates a new expense, optionally in a group or with specific friends
actions.create_expense.props.date.descri: Date and time the expense took place
actions.create_expense.props.group_id.de: Group to put this expense in (required for equal split)
actions.create_expense.props.repeat_inte: How often to repeat this expense
actions.create_expense.props.users.descr: Users and their shares for custom split (only used when Split Type is "by_shares")
auth.description:
You can generate an API key from your app's details page on Splitwise.
The API key should be kept secure as it provides access to your personal account.
description: Splitwise is a expense splitting app that helps you track and settle bills with friends, family, and roommates.
triggers.new_expense.description: Triggers when a new expense is created. Optionally, filter for a specific group.
triggers.new_expense.props.group_id.desc: Filter expenses from a specific group (optional)
